Resolves #18671
Refs #17844

The maximize arm now measures its node once the FLIP has settled. It used to read it in the frame where the class and the invert land together.
- One wait sits between the class assertion and the rect read, using the predicate #18534 established for the component and dock-example maximize arms: no inline `transform`, and no running animation on the node.
- Test-only: the arm's geometry assertions and its restore half are unchanged.

Evidence: L3 achieved — the whole `WorkstationNL` file runs against the external Brain runtime, without and with the wait, at the same base → L3 required for AC-2/AC-3. No CI workflow runs this Neural Link journey. Residual: none.
